label: products
name: Products Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR product image into one or more detailed categories based on the product's type, purpose, design, and intended use.

labels.electronics: A photo primarily showing a consumer electronic product such as a phone, television, speaker, camera, headphone, or electronic accessory.
labels.home_appliances: A photo primarily showing a household appliance such as a refrigerator, washing machine, microwave, fan, air conditioner, or vacuum cleaner.
labels.furniture: A photo primarily showing an individual furniture product such as a chair, table, sofa, bed, cabinet, or shelf.
labels.household_items: A photo primarily showing a common household product used for cleaning, storage, organization, or everyday domestic use.
labels.tools: A photo primarily showing a hand tool, power tool, repair tool, gardening tool, or workshop equipment.
labels.toys: A photo primarily showing a toy, doll, action figure, building set, puzzle, or children's play object.
labels.sports_equipment: A photo primarily showing sports or fitness equipment without active gameplay, such as a ball, racket, bat, helmet, weights, or exercise machine.
labels.kitchenware: A photo primarily showing kitchen utensils, cookware, tableware, containers, or food preparation equipment.
labels.beauty_and_personal_care: A photo primarily showing cosmetics, skincare, hair-care, grooming, perfume, or personal-care products.
labels.books_and_stationery: A photo primarily showing a book, notebook, pen, pencil, art supply, or other stationery product.
labels.musical_instruments: A photo primarily showing a musical instrument such as a guitar, keyboard, drum, violin, flute, or microphone.
labels.pet_supplies: A photo primarily showing pet products such as pet food, bowls, cages, collars, toys, or grooming supplies.
labels.baby_products: A photo primarily showing products made for babies, such as bottles, strollers, cribs, diapers, or baby-care items.
labels.automotive_products: A photo primarily showing vehicle parts or accessories such as tyres, helmets, batteries, lights, or car-care products.
labels.other_product: A photo primarily showing a physical commercial product that does not clearly match another available product type.
